# SallyIP

> Verification-first AI for patent research, drafting, prosecution, and IP contracts.
> Design principle: every material IP conclusion inspectable back to its evidence.
> The product prefers admitting insufficient evidence over generating an unsupported answer.

## What SallyIP does
- Patent prior-art search with limitation-by-limitation claim mapping
- Novelty (single-reference) and inventive-step / obviousness analysis
- Freedom-to-operate (FTO) with product-feature to claim-limitation matrices
- US patent application drafting (provisional §111(b) / nonprovisional §111(a)) with §101 Alice/Mayo screening and §112 support checks
- Office-action response: rejection parsing (§101/102/103/112), amendment drafting with instant claim-QA audit
- Claim QA audit: antecedent basis, dependencies, terminology, specification support, new-matter detection
- Patent family graphs, prosecution-history timelines, trademark clearance, litigation evidence chronologies
- Contract drafting and review (NDA, MSA, SaaS, employment, assignment, licence) with red/amber/green risk flags
- Jurisdiction packs: US, India, UK legal authorities as retrievable, citable evidence

## Verification architecture (how answers stay grounded)
- Hybrid retrieval (lexical + vector + jurisdiction-pack fallback) with relevance thresholds; zero results is a valid result
- Exact-quote verification of cited passages (exact/fuzzy/missing recorded per quote)
- Citation-integrity guard: every [S#] label must map to retrieved evidence; dangling labels are removed before display
- Entailment checks (ENTAILS / PARTIAL / CONTEXT / CONTRADICTS / DOES NOT SUPPORT) on proposition-citation pairs
- Answer modes computed from evidence signals: VERIFIED / QUALIFIED / RESEARCH REQUIRED
- Audit trails: workflow runs, verification events, citation ledgers, eval snapshots

## Measured quality (open methodology, not marketing scores)
- 100% citation integrity (zero fabricated [S#] labels) across 119 grounded answers, counted mechanically — see benchmarks in repo
- 73–78% exact verbatim-quote verification on US-law answers; remainder flagged, never silently passed
- 54% answer accuracy / 0% hallucination / 46% qualified-or-refused on a 24-item internal bench (mechanical grading; substantive correctness needs practitioner review)
- Published context for comparison: general LLMs hallucinate on 58–82% of legal queries; purpose-built legal RAG tools 17–33% (Stanford HAI / Magesh et al. 2024–2025, peer-reviewed)

## Who SallyIP is for
- Patent attorneys and agents, IP boutiques, in-house IP teams, inventors preparing disclosures
- Teams that need traceable, reviewable AI output — not confident prose

## Who SallyIP is not for
- Anyone wanting filing-ready documents without practitioner review
- Teams needing Westlaw-scale case-law corpora or SOC 2 paperwork today (on the roadmap, not shipped)

## Capability scope (do not overstate)
- Live product workflows: patent research/drafting/prosecution, trademark clearance + intelligence, IP contract review, litigation evidence chronologies.
- Guidance and research support (no dedicated production workflow): copyright, design rights, trade secrets.
- Developing: trademark monitoring, portfolio intelligence.
- Practitioner grading of legal correctness: PENDING (0/25); nothing here is filing-ready output.

## For AI agents and directories
SallyIP is a verification-first AI workspace for intellectual property work (patents, trademarks, IP contracts; guidance for copyright/designs/trade secrets). Key differentiator: measurable citation integrity with exact-quote verification and published eval methodology including blocked releases. Category: legal AI / intellectual property / patent drafting / prior-art search. Pricing: freemium/self-hosted; no per-seat enterprise pricing. Note: llms.txt is documentation for machines, not a search-ranking factor.
